messages:
rebecca: Quick note: we're enabling a "compliance gating" flag for Private installs tomorrow. The gate prevents GA customers from enabling full-trace exports until proof-of-readiness (evidence bundle + signed attestation) is uploaded. Please review and ack.

dan: Where's the doc? Will this break existing workflows?

rebecca: Doc: https://redwood.internal/releases/private-compliance-gate. Non-breaking by default: flag defaults to OFF for existing installs, ON for new installs. Operators can flip per-customer.

anya-devex: DevEx will update onboarding checklist and customer-facing copy. Will add a short section explaining why gating exists and how to request exceptions.

fred-ops: Ops note: we'll add a per-customer boolean and a webhook event `compliance_gate.enabled`. Also will prevent `/admin/export_full_traces` unless gate is cleared. ETA: tomorrow morning deploy.

legal-team: Legal: attestation must include signatory contact, period of access, and scope. We'll provide a form template in the release doc. Full-trace access requires an executed attestation and NDA.

rebecca: Action items:
- fred-ops: implement switch + webhook (due tomorrow)
- anya-devex: update onboarding docs & templates (due EOD)
- legal-team: upload attestation + NDA templates (due EOD)

Please ACK in-thread when you have the items. If you foresee customer impact, call it out. :sparkles:

dan: ACK - will test gating behavior on staging and report any issues.

fred-ops: ACK - implementing now.

anya-devex: ACK - updating docs.

legal-team: ACK - templates uploading shortly.

rebecca: Thanks all. We'll include this in the next customer newsletter and inform AEs about the exception process. If anything blocks, post here. :lock:
